description: This file defines structures and functions related to displaying tool information and configuration in the openclaw project. It includes a summary struct for tools, a registry for tool configurations loaded from JSON, and utility functions for resolving display details based on inputs.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summary of a tool's display information, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A singleton-like struct managing tool display configurations loaded from a JSON resource, with functions to resolve display summaries based on tool name and arguments.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the display info for a tool based on its name, arguments, and optional metadata, returning a ToolDisplaySummary.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the configuration from a JSON resource file, with fallback to default config if loading fails.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default configuration for tools if custom config is unavailable.
